## 🛠️ How to Get Started

1. **Comment on this issue** to let us know you're working on it — we'll assign it to you.
2. **Fork** the repo and set up your dev environment:
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/<your-username>/torchloop.git
   cd torchloop
   pip install -e ".[dev]"
   ```
3. Create a branch: `git checkout -b fix/issue-<number>-short-description`
4. Make your changes, run tests, and open a Pull Request.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the full guide.
